Dante Moore watched on as Dylan Raiola led the now No. 16 Oregon Ducks to a second straight win, jumping to 6-3 on the 2026 college football season and 4-2 in Big Ten play after a 41-28 road win over Luke Fahey and the previously No. 12 Ohio State Buckeyes. Now, Oregon will turn its attention to Week 11, returning to Eugene to host the Michigan Wolverines.
 Through the first four games of his third season with the Ducks, Moore was off to a solid start, completing 69-of-99 passes for 926 yards, nine touchdowns and zero interceptions. But in the Week 4 win over the USC Trojans, the quarterback from Detroit was hospitalized after a collision, leaving him out for the rest of the year with a concussion.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Still, despite his injury, Moore has continued to build his portfolio off the field, increasing his NIL valuation to $5 million, per On3 . He has partnered with numerous brands throughout his college career, including Nike, Celsius and Beats by Dre.
 Oregon Ducks quarterback Dante Moore (5) throws a pass.Dale Zanine-Imagn Images
 And ahead of Oregon's matchup against Michigan, Moore shared his newest NIL partner, teaming up with the skincare brand NIVEA MEN. The new partnership highlights NIVEA MEN's liquid moisturizers.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Different day. Same standard. 🏈 @niveamenusa #sponsored #niveamenusa," Moore wrote on Instagram.
 Included in the post was a video of Moore displaying the easy use of the NIVEA MEN product, noting that it helps him throughout his busy football week.
 "Every day is different," Moore said. "But the routine stays pretty consistent. One thing I don't have to overthink: my skincare. NIVEA MEN liquid moisturizers are a quick add to my routine. It takes seconds to apply. It's lightweight, keeps my skin hydrated and gets me feeling fresh before I'm out the door.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Then it's meetings, workouts, practice and everything in between. When you're an athlete, your day can move pretty fast. I want my routine to do the same. Whether I'm getting ready for practice or heading into the rest of my day, NIVEA MEN keeps it simple. Stay fresh. Stay ready. Keep moving."
 Oregon will face Michigan on Saturday at 3:30 p.m. ET.
